spaces.//: 180 KiB. Raised from 176,128 in the portability commit: the page extract and the subtree import (spaces/src/portable.ts, the graft UI, 24 new strings x 8 catalogs) took the shell from 166,482 to 175,690 B — 9,208 B, 5.5%. That left 438 B under the old ceiling, which is inside the packer's own cross-node-version spread (measured elsewhere at ~1.1 KB), so the ceiling moves to keep CI honest rather than flaky. Headroom is deliberate for that reason and CI is the number that counts. Zopfli bought the previous round 7,116 B without dropping a feature; this round spends genuine headroom on the two exits the format promised.
